reviews.name: 꾸***
reviews.content:
꼬물꼬물 테일즈도 정말 잘 갖고 놀아서 이번 새로운 제품도 기대가 너무 되었어요! 터그놀이를 잘 하지 않는데 이 제품은 바스락 거리는 천을 물고 놀 수 있어서 꼬리를 물고 터그놀이 해요!
멀리서 바스락 거리면 간식인 줄 알고 뛰어 오다가 장난감인거 알고 분한지 아니면 놀고싶어서 그런 건지 꼬리 물고 이리저리 고개 돌리면서 놀아요ㅋㅋㅋ꼬물꼬물 테일즈 잘 가지고 놀앗으면 이 제품도 강추합니다!
reviews.content_en: My pup loves the Kkomul Kkomul Tales so much, so I was really excited about this new product! My dog isn't usually into tug-of-war, but with this toy she can bite the crinkly fabric and play tug with her tail! 😄 When she hears the crinkle from far away, she thinks it's a treat and comes running, but once she realizes it's a toy, she either gets pouty or wants to play—either way, she grabs it by the tail and shakes her head back and forth playing with it lol. If your pup loves Kkomul Kkomul Tales, I highly recommend this product too!

reviews.name: 후추
reviews.content:
파닥파닥 꼬리가 길어서 고양이도 잘 갖고 놀겠다 싶었거든요!
역시나~~ 너무 좋아하네요! 꼬리로 사냥 놀이하기 성공입니다 :>
바스락 소리도 나서 귀를 쫑긋 하고 사냥해요 ㅎㅎ 
강아지 친구들은 삑삑소리도 나니 더 좋아할것 같아요!
reviews.content_en:
I got this because the long fluttery tail looked like something my cat would love!
And I was right~~ She absolutely loves it! Mission accomplished on the hunting play! 🎉 The crinkly sound makes her perk up her ears and "hunt" it too lol. I think dog friends would love it even more because of the squeaky sound!

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content: 계란처럼 생긴 삑삑이가 있는데 너무 소리가 커서 다른거 찾아보다 구매했어요~ 좀 힘없는 피슉피슉 삑삑이 소리긴한데.. 귀는 편하고 강아지는 즐거워합니닼ㅋㅋ 바스락이 같이 있어서 더 좋아해요
reviews.content_en: There's this egg-shaped squeaker toy that's super loud, so I went looking for something else and bought this~~ It does have a softer pssss-pssss squeaking sound... which is easier on the ears, and my pup has a blast with it lol. Love that it has the crinkle too!

reviews.name: 류****
reviews.content_en: The size is lol smaller than I expected lol so shocking lol even though my pup is kind of big.. it turned out to be a tiny toy lol he's not interested in it at all lol
